verdict.rationale: First-party self-hosting docs state that LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure. They also include a Docker Compose deployment guide, SSO provider configuration (GitHub, Google, Okta, Keycloak) and integration examples such as Ollama and Azure OpenAI. Community evidence confirms the repo is Apache-2 licensed. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a successful self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
